description: List and filter raw rate rows (the core data primitive) by product, state, lender, and term with limit/offset pagination. Boats, RVs, motorcycles, and powersports are first-class product types; auto_loan means cars. For a proven RV APR comparison, pass product_type=rv and quality=verified. To match RV pricing to a lender-published numeric score bucket, pass product_type=rv and credit_score; this returns proven nominal rates and their exact published buckets, not an approval prediction.

audience.description: WHO the product is for, orthogonal to product type: 'business' returns business-audience products across every category (DSCR mortgages, business deposits, SBA loans); 'consumer' excludes them.

credit_score.description: RV-only inclusive match against numeric credit-score buckets published by each lender. Requires product_type=rv, implies rankable_only, defaults to rate_asc, and compares nominal rate rather than APR. Letter-only tiers are never converted to scores.

quality.description: RV-only fail-closed, row-bound APR comparison mode. Requires product_type=rv and returns source evidence.

rankable_only.description: Use only rows eligible to win a comparison. quality=verified or credit_score matching implies true.

state.description: 2-letter US state code; omit for all states

name: list_rates

as_of.description: UTC timestamp of the newest rate in this result set; the whole page is at least this stale.

comparison_policy.description: Present in quality=verified or credit_score mode: the versioned comparison policy, actual metric, deterministic requirements, and any underwriting disclaimer.

filters.description: The filters that were applied to produce these rows; null members were not constrained.

audience.description: Borrower-audience filter, e.g. first-time buyer programs. Null means unrestricted.

credit_score.description: Requested borrower score for an RV published-bucket match. Null means score matching was not requested.

lender.description: Lender name filter applied. Null means all lenders.

loan_program.description: Loan program filter such as 'conventional' or 'va'. Null means all programs.

max_apr.description: Upper APR bound applied, in percent. Null means no ceiling.

min_apr.description: Lower APR bound applied, in percent. Null means no floor.

occupancy.description: Occupancy filter such as primary residence or investment property. Null means unrestricted.

product_type.description: Product category filter applied, e.g. 'mortgage'. Null means all categories.

quality.description: 'verified' for the fail-closed RV APR comparison contract; null for the ordinary catalog.

rankable_only.description: True when context-only rows were excluded so every returned observation is eligible to win a comparison. quality=verified or credit_score matching implies true.

sort.description: Ordering applied to the rows, e.g. 'apr_asc' (cheapest APR first).

state.description: Two-letter state filter applied. Null means nationwide.

term_months.description: Term filter in months. Null means all terms were included, so rows may mix 15- and 30-year products.

match_coverage.description: Present in credit_score mode: makes explicit that pagination.total counts only proven numeric score-bucket matches for the requested score, never the full RV catalog. Use get_coverage for total RV and score-matchable inventory.

pagination.description: Where this page sits within the full result set.

has_more.description: True when further pages of matching rows remain beyond this one.

limit.description: Maximum rows requested for this page.

offset.description: Number of rows skipped before this page.

returned.description: Rows actually included in this response.

total.description: Total rows matching the filters across all pages — usually far larger than `returned`. Use this when telling the user how many offers exist.

rates.description: The matching rate rows for this page, in the order given by filters.sort.

apr.description: Annual percentage rate in percent, including lender fees. NULL when the lender published no APR — the API deliberately does not substitute the note rate, so never present `rate` as an APR. Some legacy rows still carry an APR equal to the note rate; those heal on that credit union's next scrape.

as_of.description: UTC timestamp when this individual rate was last scraped from the lender.

comparison.description: Present in quality=verified or credit_score mode: the actual metric, policy version, publication metadata, and provenance role. credit_score mode reports nominal_rate, never APR.

credit_score_match.description: Present when credit_score was supplied: requested score, inclusive published minimum/maximum, optional lender tier label, and published_numeric_bucket match type.

display_name.description: Normalized, human-readable product name for comparison across lenders.

eligibility.description: Membership-eligibility snapshot for this lender, including status, charter type, and confidence; 'unknown' status means it could not be evaluated for this user.

evidence.description: Present in quality=verified or credit_score mode: the lender source URL, verbatim proof quote, proof-verification flag, and any source effective date.

lender.description: Full name of the credit union publishing this rate.

loan_purpose.description: Purpose the rate applies to, e.g. 'purchase' or 'refinance'. Null means the lender did not distinguish.

points.description: Discount points required for this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

product_key.description: Internal pipe-delimited product fingerprint used for deduplication; never show it to the user.

product_name.description: The lender's own wording for the product, e.g. 'Home Purchases/Refinances 7 & 1 Year ARM'.

rate.description: Note rate in percent (6.125 = 6.125%), excluding fees. On an ARM this is only the initial rate.

rate_phase.description: Which phase of the rate this row describes: 'standard' for the ordinary rate, versus an introductory or teaser phase on ARMs and promotional products.

rateapi_url.description: Public rateapi.dev profile page for this lender.

state.description: Two-letter state code of the lender.

term_months.description: Term in months for this product. Null when the lender did not publish a term, common for ARMs and lines of credit.

vehicle_condition.description: For auto loans, whether the rate applies to a new or used vehicle. Null for non-auto products.

vehicle_type.description: For vehicle loans, the vehicle class (car, RV, boat, motorcycle). Null on non-vehicle products; null on an auto loan means a car.
